agreement_date.evidence: THIS AGREEMENT made as of the 30th day of June 1999

effective_date.evidence: The effective date of the start of the Term will be from the Launch Date.

expiration_date.evidence: The term of this Agreement shall be for a period of two (2) years (the "Term"). The effective date of the start of the Term will be from the Launch Date.

governing_law.evidence: This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted and enforced in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario and the Parties agree to abide by the jurisdiction of the Courts of Ontario.

non_compete.evidence: HCI shall not either directly or indirectly license or deliver content to or carry on or be engaged with any other Canadian portal web site, being a Web site which aggregates and markets a variety of content directed to multiple communities of interest and which offers products, tools and services to a broad base of Canadian end users.

exclusivity.evidence: During the Term of the Agreement, and subject to the following requirements respecting Canadian content levels as set out in paragraphs 3(f), (g) and (h), HCI shall be the exclusive health content partner in the health section of the Sympatico web site
